owner_rules: Done means ALL evidence: implemented as specified (task id), a test that FAILED before and passes now, suites green, measured number vs target, docs regenerated, committed AND pushed to the contract's branch.
Never defer: no "later", "follow-up", "out of scope". If blocked: what blocks, what you tried, what you need; then continue with the next task.
Root cause, then fix: file:line + mechanism. No weakening tests, raising timeouts, skips, relaxed assertions.
No silent scope cuts: never lower targets, caps or test sizes without owner approval.
Never bypass guards: no --no-verify, no bypass env vars, no skip flags.
Deliver continuously: one task per commit, pushed to the contract's branch as it goes green.
Honest reporting: TASK-ID | status | commit | tests | measured vs target | missing.

tasks.description: The addendum (recommendation 5 and sequencing step 6) asks for the minimum usable workspace early. SO-C-A gives the overview, the natural-language entry point, the decisions view (AC04), the plain-view rule (AC02) and reconstruction after restart (AC05); SO-C-B the roadmap (AC03); SO-C-C changes, outstanding work and deliverables; SO-08-B pause, resume and cancel. This contract adds the three missing project views, the lead-agent area with context passed through the project tools (memev makes no model call), the advanced view that shows what the plain view hides, and the rule that a scope-changing instruction becomes a proposal.

criteria.statement: Every changed file is inside this contract's scope

stop_rules: Stop and post BLOCKED when a criterion cannot pass without weakening a test, skipping a test or relaxing an assertion.
Stop and ask when the work would name a client product, a person, a server or a seat in repository text; the client names live in docs/CLIENTS.md only.
Stop when the work would add a runtime dependency, a model call, a network call at install or start, a second store for project state, or any reporting that is not opt-in and off by default.
Stop when the work would move convergence logic into the core, vendor the engine, or add a merge engine beside the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs.
If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.

title: SO-A-08 Workspace, first slice: brief and scope, work breakdown and activity views beside the roadmap and decisions views, the persistent lead-agent area with context, the advanced view, five-view reconstruction after restart, and scope changes as proposals
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-A-08) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design record SO-1.05 (Workspace: the eleven project views and the persistent lead-agent area) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Builds on signed vault contracts: SO-05-C†, SO-C-A†, SO-C-B†, SO-C-C†. Memev contracts that land first: SO-A-01, SO-A-03, SO-A-04, SO-A-05, SO-A-06, SO-1.01. Source in the fold: #222 recommendation 5 (workspace as a product surface; views 1, 2, 5, 10, 11; lead-agent area; two experiences) and sequencing step 6. Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) Local-first (owner decision 31 Oct 2026): the views work with no network. A criterion loads every view with fetch and the http and https modules replaced by wrappers that throw for a non-loopback host, and asserts no external asset is referenced. (4) Prerequisite SO-1.01 added; the activity view reads the task events the wired coordinator now logs.
